Zonhoven

Sunday 3 January 2027

Zonhoven promises more cyclo-cross spectacle in the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup on Sunday 3 January. The legendary 'Kuil' makes this ninth round one of the most spectacular of the season. Last year, Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel triumphed. Who will follow in their footsteps in the famous ‘Kuil’ of Zonhoven?

Tickets

Would you like to join us in Zonhoven on Sunday 3 January? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Presale: €21.50 (service fee included)

On race day, both at the on-site ticket office and online: €25.00 (service fee included)

Children born in 2015 or later can enter for free, but must still order a child ticket.

 

[GO TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://zonhoven.tickets.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/selection?language=en)

Practical information

Address

Kapelbergweg 50, 3520 Zonhoven

 

Do you have a question?

Contact the organisation [here](https://www.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/en/contact).

How to get there?

By bike

A bicycle parking area is available near Kapelbergweg 50 in Zonhoven. Be sure to bring a bike lock.

 

By public transport

From Genk station: take bus line 465 (Genk – Zonhoven) and get off at the Elstrekenweg stop.
From Hasselt station: take bus line 12 (Hasselt – Genk Station), then change to bus line 465 (Genk – Zonhoven) and get off at the Elstrekenweg stop.

 

By car

Take the E314 and exit at junction 29 (Houthalen-Helchteren), then follow the signs towards De Waerde (Berkenenstraat 49, 3520 Zonhoven).
